en: Hey, what's your orphanage like?
What's it like...?
I only know orphanages from books and stuff...

But I wanted to know what it was like at
yours.

...Again, I'm not sure what you're expecting,
but it wasn't anything particularly weird.

If I had to describe it for you, it's like going
to camp. One with children of all ages.

A camp, huh?
Then, do you cook together?

Not really. We had a cook who prepared us
three meals a day.

But we had to clean up after ourselves.
We also had to do our own laundry.

However, we'd help the younger kids do theirs
until they learned how to do it.

Ooh! And that's how you became the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Child Caregiver<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right!?

...I won't deny it, but it's not like I did
anything special.

We all lived under the same roof. So obviously,
we had to help each other out.

Yeah, just like how family members help
each other out.

Is that so? I didn't have a family, so I
wouldn't know.
Oh...s-sorry...
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn it. I was totally being inconsiderate.

U-Um... Do you hang out with them on the
weekends?

It depends, but we usually did since the older
children had to take care of them anyway.

Since we didn't have much of an allowance,
many of our toys were old...

Some of the kids wanted newer games,
and that got pretty problematic.

Now that you mention it... Did you guys
have any cell phones or gaming consoles?
No...we didn't have anything like that.

Once you get to high school, you can start
earning money from jobs, but that's about it.
Hmm, I see... There wasn't much to do then.

The teacher at the orphanage thought we
didn't have much to do, either.

Hey, how about I come over and play the
piano for you guys?
...Huh? What's that?

What? You don't know what a piano is?
Don't they have one at the orphanage?
Oh, yeah...there might be an old upright piano.

Then, I just need to go there.
How about it?

Asking that might be a problem. I don't have
any authority to make that kind of decision.

Oh, that's true. Hahaha, sorry for inviting
myself... I got too excited.

But I'm serious! When we escape from here,
can you ask the teacher for permission?

...You're such a busybody. What good will
come of that?

Don't think like that. Like they say,
"Selfish help is better than no help at all."

You actually believe...we'll be able to get
out of here...

Of course! And we all need to work
together to do that!
Hmmm...

I'm gonna be honest... You're annoying. But I
guess we need people like you in the world.

<CLT=cltMIND>A-Annoying...
Maki's insults are always so harsh...
<CLT=cltMIND>But she doesn't seem like a bad person...

<CLT=cltMIND>If she's being this straightforward with me,
does that mean we're closer now?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Maki's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Maki, I returned
to my room.
